object.name: evi.rectify~
object.description: <o>evi.rectify~</o> is a simple passive audio signal rectifer. Rectification waveshapes an audio signal so that only positive vallues remain in the output giving a digital distorted effect. <o>evi.rectify~</o> is antialiased via anti derivative antialiasing and dcblocked, so that the resulting signal is cleaner and softer than a mathematical rectification.
object.discussion: See the helpfile for an example of how to cope with unknown input ranges.

inlets.description: Audio input is expected not to exceed -1..1

outlets.description: Output is rectified, antialiased and dcblocked
